parameters.query:
SELECT
  t.id,
  t.user_phone,
  t.title,
  t.category,
  t.scheduled_time::text,
  t.reminder_minutes_before,
  COALESCE(t.scheduled_type, 'hora') AS scheduled_type,
  u.frist_name,
  u.gender,
  u.created_from,
  u.last_interaction_at,
  CASE
    WHEN t.reminder_minutes_before IS NOT NULL
      AND t.scheduled_time - (t.reminder_minutes_before || ' minutes')::interval
          BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time
              AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time + interval '5 minutes')
    THEN 'lembrete_antecipado'
    WHEN t.scheduled_time BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time
                              AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time + interval '5 minutes')
    THEN 'lembrete'
    WHEN t.scheduled_time < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time
    THEN 'confirmacao'
    ELSE 'lembrete'
  END AS tipo_envio
FROM tasks t
JOIN users u ON u.phone = t.user_phone
JOIN active_subscriptions sub ON sub.user_phone = t.user_phone
WHERE t.status = 'open'
  AND t.due_date_typed = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
  AND t.scheduled_time IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    -- LEMBRETE: tarefa está nos próximos 5 minutos (olha pra frente)
    (
      t.scheduled_time BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time
                           AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time + interval '5 minutes')
      AND (t.last_reminder_sent_at IS NULL OR now() - t.last_reminder_sent_at > interval '5 minutes')
    )
    OR
    -- LEMBRETE ANTECIPADO: usuário pediu X minutos antes
    (
      t.reminder_minutes_before IS NOT NULL
      AND (t.last_reminder_sent_at IS NULL OR now() - t.last_reminder_sent_at > interval '5 minutes')
      AND t.scheduled_time - (t.reminder_minutes_before || ' minutes')::interval
          BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time
              AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time + interval '5 minutes')
    )
    OR
    -- CONFIRMAÇÃO: tarefa já passou, ainda não confirmou
    (
      t.confirmation_sent = false
      AND t.scheduled_time < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time
      AND t.scheduled_time >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::time - interval '5 minutes')
    )
  )

UPDATE tasks SET
  last_reminder_sent_at = now(),
  confirmation_sent = CASE 
    WHEN id = ANY(ARRAY[{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.task_ids.join(',') }}]::int[])
      AND {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.tarefas.some(t => t.tipo_disparo === 'confirmacao') }} = true
    THEN true
    ELSE confirmation_sent
  END
WHERE id = ANY(ARRAY[{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.task_ids.join(',') }}]::int[])
